comment: SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s conformance cases from NIST's ACVP server. Signing and verification use the external signature interface, pure (not prehashed). Key generation cases carry the three key seeds separately; verification cases carry NIST's own reason for the result it expects, which for the valid ones says the signature should verify; signing cases are byte-for-byte comparisons.

sigVer.reason: valid signature and message - signature should verify successfully
